note: Minor requirements for the app, built from the official minor files in backend/data/minors/ (one file per minor) and, for Product Management, which has no official file, from its 2026-27 CMU catalog page archived in backend/data/sources/catalog-2026-27/minors/ (its source_file). Each minor is a tree of categories. A category lists its courses by code (courses), matches them by number (select), or holds sub categories (children). One course fills one category. Old Psychology numbers in the files are shown as their current numbers. Codes that are in no catalog stay listed and simply match no course. Double counting limits are the audit file's (the catalog page's for Product Management); overlap with general education never uses up a limit.
